caveat: These numbers were measured against a demonstration corpus of 9 illustrative documents, not against the real source set. No document from `corpus/manifest.json` has been ingested, because none has a verified source URL. So most questions here abstain for want of anything to answer from, and the abstention and coverage figures below measure the machinery rather than the product's coverage. The purity and groundedness figures are meaningful now; the coverage figures will only become meaningful once documents are ingested.
